exposure: Spontaneous onset preterm breech deliveries after trial of labor (BTOL)
Intended cesarean section (BCS) for preterm breech deliveries
cohort: 176 preterm breech and 103 vertex control deliveries, matched by gestational age and whether the mother had given birth vaginally before, in a Finnish University Hospital between 2003 and 2015
finding: In breech deliveries at 32(+0)-36(+6) gestational weeks, trial of labor did not increase neonatal morbidity compared to intended cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Median blood loss was more pronounced in the intended cesarean section group compared to the trial of labor group.
